title: Automatic pneumatic cylinder
brief: Move a box using a spring-return cylinder. The sensors can be operated manually or by the virtual plant.
requirements: Start PB (I0.0) is the cycle button. Box Present (I0.1) detects a box. Retracted Sensor (I0.2) and Extended Sensor (I0.3) report the cylinder position. Cylinder Extend (Q0.0) energises the spring-return cylinder.

Use the INT Sequence Step (MW10), initially 0. In step 0, keep Cylinder Extend (Q0.0) OFF. Start a new cycle only when Start PB has a fresh OFF-to-ON transition, Box Present is ON and Retracted Sensor is ON.
Step 10: turn Cylinder Extend (Q0.0) ON and wait until Extended Sensor (I0.3) becomes ON. Do not advance merely because time has passed.
Step 20: keep Cylinder Extend (Q0.0) ON for another 2 seconds after the extended position is reached.
Step 30: switch Cylinder Extend (Q0.0) OFF and wait for Retracted Sensor (I0.2) to become ON. Return Sequence Step (MW10) to 0 when the cylinder has retracted.
A new cycle requires a new press of Start PB (I0.0). Step Snapshot (MW12) is available if needed to prevent unwanted multiple transitions in one PLC scan.
objective: Use position sensors as transition conditions.
hints: Use rising-edge Start and the two permissives for the first transition.
Use step comparisons with end sensors and one hold TON; Extend is ON in steps 10 and 20.
